title: fix(plugin-tree): annotate tree-config filter param to satisfy noImplicitAny
body:
## Summary
`packages/plugin-tree/src/ObjectTree.tsx:84` failed `tsc --noEmit` with:

```
src/ObjectTree.tsx(84,45): error TS7006: Parameter 'f' implicitly has an 'any' type.
```

`rawFields` resolves to `any` (it comes from `schema: any`), so `.map(fieldKey)` is `any` and the filter callback param `f` was implicitly `any` under `noImplicitAny`. Annotated it as `unknown`; the `f is string` type predicate still narrows the result to `string[]`.

This error is **pre-existing on main** (CI has no `tsc --noEmit` gate, so it was never caught) and is **unrelated** to the @objectstack 11 upgrade.

## Verify
```
pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-tree type-check
```
The `84,45` implicit-any error is gone.
